_meta.description: T2 — monthly retainer-billing engine per client/project. Declares four schemas: RetainerPool (monthly allocation with effective-period + rollover policy + operator-driven lifecycle draft→active→closed→archived per REQ-RETN-001), RetainerDrawdown (immutable per-time-entry consumption tracking per REQ-RETN-002, status enum pending|materialized|reversed|adjusted), RetainerRollover (immutable carryover-or-reset between consecutive periods per REQ-RETN-004, with carryoverCapApplied audit flag), and RetainerTrueUp (period-end reconciliation per REQ-RETN-006 with operator-driven generated→pending-approval→approved→invoiced→settled→reversed lifecycle and approver attribution per REQ-RETN-011). Amounts (poolAmount, drawdownAmount, carryoverAmount, actualDrawdown, overageAmount, overageInvoiceAmount) are MonetaryAmount-typed numbers persisted with multipleOf 0.01 (2-decimal Euro precision); rates (retainerRate, drawdownRate, overageRate) use multipleOf 0.01. Aggregations declared via x-openregister-aggregations: RetainerPool exposes drawdownsByPool (sum of RetainerDrawdown.drawdownAmount + rollover carryover for available-balance queries per REQ-RETN-003) and trueUpByPool (count of materialized RetainerTrueUp records); RetainerTrueUp exposes drawdownsForPeriod (actualDrawdown = sum of in-period RetainerDrawdown for true-up generation per REQ-RETN-006). Non-overlapping (clientId, projectId, period) validation per REQ-RETN-001 enforced through x-openregister-uniqueness preconditions. Approvals wire to ADR-023 mandate-delegation via x-openregister-rbac roles retainer-administrator/bookkeeper/approver/auditor. Seeds load two example pools (Gemeente Amsterdam Jan-2026 with overspend, TechStartup BV Jan-2026 partial-spend with reset policy), four matching drawdowns, two true-ups (Gemeente Jan with €375 overage @ €85/h standard rate = €425 billable; TechStartup Jan partial-spend with no overage, settled), and two rollovers (Gemeente Feb opening with carryover=0 after overspend, TechStartup Feb opening with reset). Reuses existing RateCardTemplate / RateCardVersion / RateSchedule from rate-card-engine for overage-rate lookup per REQ-RETN-005 (no rate model is duplicated).

RetainerPool.title: Retainer Pool
RetainerPool.description: A monthly retainer allocation per client (and optional project) with an effective-period window, a fixed pool amount in the pool currency, a per-hour or per-day retainer rate used to convert time-entry hours into drawdown amount, and a rollover policy (carryover cap in amount or hours, or reset-balance for monthly reset). One pool per (clientId, projectId, period) combination; overlapping periods for the same (client, project) pair MUST be rejected. Operator-driven lifecycle draft → active → closed → archived; once closed, pool amount/rate/policy are immutable so the true-up calculation remains deterministic (Design D6).

clientId.description: FK to the client this retainer pool serves (Nextcloud contact UID or external customer id).
clientId.title: Client ID

projectId.description: Optional FK to a specific project within the client's engagement; null means pool is client-wide.
projectId.title: Project ID

poolAmount.description: Allocated retainer amount for the period in the pool currency.
poolAmount.title: Pool Amount

retainerRate.description: Rate (per hour or per day, see retainerRateUnit) used to convert time-entry hours into drawdownAmount for this pool (REQ-RETN-002, Design D2). NOT the standard billing rate — that is resolved per RateCard for overage.
retainerRate.title: Retainer Rate

retainerRateUnit.description: Unit for retainerRate. 'fixed' means the pool is amount-based (no hourly conversion).
retainerRateUnit.title: Retainer Rate Unit

rolloverPolicy.description: Per-pool rollover policy (REQ-RETN-004, Design D3). carryoverMaxAmount and carryoverMaxHours are mutually-exclusive caps; resetBalance=true forces carryover=0 regardless of caps.

resetBalance.description: If true, unused balance is discarded at period-end (no carryover).
resetBalance.title: Reset Balance

carryoverMaxAmount.description: Maximum unused balance carried forward in the pool currency. Null = unlimited.
carryoverMaxAmount.title: Carryover Max Amount

carryoverMaxHours.description: Maximum unused balance carried forward in hours (converted at retainerRate). Null = unlimited.
carryoverMaxHours.title: Carryover Max Hours

carryoverCapUnit.description: Which cap takes precedence when both are configured.
carryoverCapUnit.title: Carryover Cap Unit

rolloverPolicy.title: Rollover Policy

administrationId.description: FK to the administration that owns this pool; reads are scoped per administration.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

status.description: Pool lifecycle state. draft = editable; active = drawdowns accepted; closed = period elapsed and true-up generated; archived = read-only audit trail.
status.title: Status

sourcePoolId.description: FK to the prior-period pool when this pool was auto-created via rollover.
sourcePoolId.title: Source Pool ID

retention.description: Retainer pools (commercial agreements + billing audit trail) 7 jaar bewaren (Algemene Wet inzake Rijksbelastingen art. 52).

draft.label: Concept
draft.description: Operator can edit pool amount, rate, period, and policy.

active.label: Actief
active.description: Time entries within the period materialise drawdowns; balance queries are live.

closed.label: Afgesloten
closed.description: Period has elapsed and the period-end true-up has been generated; pool fields are immutable.

archived.label: Gearchiveerd
archived.description: Read-only audit trail; no further mutations.

activate.label: Activeren
activate.description: Activate the pool so drawdowns can be recorded.

close.label: Afsluiten
close.description: Close the pool for the elapsed period; triggers true-up generation per REQ-RETN-006.

archive.label: Archiveren
archive.description: Move pool to read-only audit state after settlement.

drawdownsByPool.description: Declarative shape of the drawdown-balance aggregation. Sums RetainerDrawdown.drawdownAmount for this pool where drawdownDate <= as-of-date and status in (materialized, adjusted). The available-balance UI computes poolAmount - drawnAmount + sum(RetainerRollover.carryoverAmount where targetPeriodPoolId=@self.id).

trueUpsByPool.description: Declarative count of period-end true-ups attached to this pool. Used by the detail view to prevent duplicate true-up creation per REQ-RETN-007.

nonOverlappingPeriod.description: Per REQ-RETN-001, two active/closed RetainerPool records for the same (clientId, projectId) pair MUST NOT have overlapping [periodStart, periodEnd] windows. The precondition validates on transition draft→active. Error message: 'Retainer pool exists for {client} in period {start}..{end}; overlapping periods not allowed'.

RetainerDrawdown.title: Retainer Drawdown
RetainerDrawdown.description: Immutable per-time-entry consumption record against a RetainerPool. Created automatically by the TimeEntry create lifecycle hook (REQ-RETN-002, Design D2). drawdownAmount = hoursOrAmount × drawdownRate where drawdownRate is the pool's retainerRate at materialization time — NOT the timesheet's billable rate (Design D2 + REQ-RETN-002). Once status=materialized, the record is read-only; reversal/adjustment creates a new record linking back via reversalOfDrawdownId.

poolId.description: FK to the RetainerPool being consumed.
poolId.title: Pool ID

timeEntryId.description: FK to the consuming TimeEntry (audit link).
timeEntryId.title: Time Entry ID

drawdownDate.description: Date of the underlying time entry; used by the available-balance aggregation filter.
drawdownDate.title: Drawdown Date

hoursOrAmount.description: Hours (or fixed amount when pool.retainerRateUnit = 'fixed') consumed by the time entry.
hoursOrAmount.title: Hours Or Amount

drawdownRate.description: Snapshot of the pool's retainerRate at the moment of materialization (Design D2). Immutable.
drawdownRate.title: Drawdown Rate

drawdownAmount.description: Computed drawdown amount in pool currency = hoursOrAmount × drawdownRate.
drawdownAmount.title: Drawdown Amount

administrationId.description: FK to the administration this drawdown belongs to.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

status.description: Drawdown status. materialized = active consumption; reversed = the underlying time entry was deleted/reversed (drawdownAmount no longer counts); adjusted = superseded by a new drawdown with different rate/amount (audit trail preserved).
status.title: Status

reversalOfDrawdownId.description: FK to the prior drawdown this record reverses or adjusts (REQ-RETN-002, immutable audit). Null for original drawdowns.
reversalOfDrawdownId.title: Reversal Of Drawdown ID

description.description: Cached time-entry description for the drawdown ledger view.
description.title: Description

RetainerRollover.title: Retainer Rollover
RetainerRollover.description: Immutable carryover record between consecutive RetainerPools for the same (clientId, projectId) pair. On pool close (lifecycle.close), a RetainerRollover is created capturing the unused balance, the cap that was applied (if any), and whether reset-balance forced carryover to zero. Adjustments MUST create a new record (status=adjusted) referencing the original via adjustsRolloverId; original record is never mutated (Design D6).

targetPeriodPoolId.description: FK to the next-period RetainerPool that received the carryover. Null until the next pool is created.
targetPeriodPoolId.title: Target Period Pool ID

carryoverAmount.description: Amount carried forward in pool currency. Zero when resetBalance=true or pool overspent.
carryoverAmount.title: Carryover Amount

carryoverHours.description: Hours equivalent of carryoverAmount (= carryoverAmount / retainerRate); null when retainerRateUnit='fixed'.
carryoverHours.title: Carryover Hours

carryoverCapApplied.description: True when the unused balance exceeded the policy cap and was trimmed (REQ-RETN-004 audit).
carryoverCapApplied.title: Carryover Cap Applied

capValueApplied.description: Cap value that was used (in amount or in hours converted to amount) when carryoverCapApplied=true.
capValueApplied.title: Cap Value Applied

resetBalance.description: Mirrors the policy at execution time; true forces carryoverAmount=0.
resetBalance.title: Reset Balance

administrationId.description: FK to the administration this rollover belongs to.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

status.description: Rollover lifecycle (Design D6). planned = forecast preview; executed = immutable; adjusted = superseded with audit trail; archived = read-only.
status.title: Status

adjustsRolloverId.description: FK to a prior rollover this record adjusts (audit chain).
adjustsRolloverId.title: Adjusts Rollover ID

RetainerTrueUp.title: Retainer True-Up
RetainerTrueUp.description: Period-end reconciliation record per RetainerPool (REQ-RETN-006, Design D5). Auto-created by the period-close lifecycle hook (RetainerPool.transitions.close) or by manual operator trigger. Captures actualDrawdown vs. poolAmount, the resolved overage rate via rate-card-engine, and the resulting overageInvoiceAmount destined for adjustment-invoice generation. Operator-driven lifecycle generated → pending-approval → approved → invoiced → settled, with reversed as an out-of-band correction state. Approvals require the retainer:approve-true-up permission per ADR-023.

actualDrawdown.description: Sum of RetainerDrawdown.drawdownAmount across the pool period.
actualDrawdown.title: Actual Drawdown

poolAmount.description: Snapshot of RetainerPool.poolAmount at true-up generation (immutable audit).
poolAmount.title: Pool Amount

overageAmount.description: max(0, actualDrawdown - poolAmount), in pool currency.
overageAmount.title: Overage Amount

overageRate.description: Standard rate resolved from rate-card-engine. Null if no overage.
overageRate.title: Overage Rate

overageInvoiceAmount.description: Overage converted from retainer-rate hours into standard-rate billing amount: overageAmount / retainerRate × overageRate. Zero when overageAmount=0.
overageInvoiceAmount.title: Overage Invoice Amount

underUtilisationAmount.description: max(0, poolAmount - actualDrawdown), in pool currency. Reported for credit-note workflows.
underUtilisationAmount.title: Under Utilisation Amount

administrationId.description: FK to the administration this true-up belongs to.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

generatedBy.description: Operator UID that triggered the true-up (or 'system' for auto-close). Audit log.
generatedBy.title: Generated By

approvedBy.description: UID of the approver who advanced generated → approved (ADR-023, REQ-RETN-011).
approvedBy.title: Approved By

invoiceId.description: FK to the generated adjustment Invoice once status=invoiced.
invoiceId.title: Invoice ID

reversalOfTrueUpId.description: FK to a prior true-up this record reverses/adjusts (REQ-RETN-007 audit chain). Null for first-time true-ups.
reversalOfTrueUpId.title: Reversal Of True Up ID

manualTriggerReason.description: Free-text reason when triggered manually after a missed auto-close.
manualTriggerReason.title: Manual Trigger Reason

retention.description: Billing reconciliation records 7 jaar bewaren (Algemene Wet inzake Rijksbelastingen art. 52).

generated.label: Gegenereerd
generated.description: Auto- or manually-created; awaiting approver review.

pending-approval.label: Wacht op goedkeuring
pending-approval.description: Submitted for approval; approver mandate per ADR-023.

approved.label: Goedgekeurd
approved.description: Approved by an authorised approver; awaiting invoice generation.

invoiced.label: Gefactureerd
invoiced.description: Adjustment invoice created and linked via invoiceId.

settled.label: Afgehandeld
settled.description: Invoice paid or under-utilisation absorbed; rollover-to-next-period allowed.

reversed.label: Teruggedraaid
reversed.description: Out-of-band correction; preserves audit chain via reversalOfTrueUpId.

approve.label: Goedkeuren
approve.description: Approver advances true-up; sets approvedBy + approvalDate.

invoice.label: Factureren
invoice.description: Generate adjustment invoice if overageAmount > 0; sets invoiceId.

settle.label: Afhandelen
settle.description: Mark settled once invoice is paid or under-utilisation is absorbed.

reverse.label: Terugdraaien
reverse.description: Reverse an approved true-up out-of-band; creates a new generated true-up linked via reversalOfTrueUpId.

drawdownsForPeriod.description: Declarative shape of the actualDrawdown derivation. Sums RetainerDrawdown.drawdownAmount where poolId=@self.poolId AND drawdownDate BETWEEN pool.periodStart AND pool.periodEnd AND status='materialized'.
